definitions.explanation: The basic materials or substances used to manufacture or produce something. Commonly seen on food labels listing ingredients and in manufacturing contexts.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: The price of raw materials has gone up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{原材料|げんざいりょう}⟦{表示|ひょうじ}→表示：03143_hyouji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}した→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧。
examples.english: I checked the ingredients list on the food product.

examples.japanese: {原材料|げんざいりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧、⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値上|ねあ}げ→値上げ：07582_neage⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{避|さ}けられない→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧。
examples.english: Due to soaring raw material costs, price increases on products are unavoidable.

notes:
Composed of {原|げん} (original, raw) + ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧ (material, ingredient).

FOOD CONTEXT:
Very commonly seen on Japanese food packaging under {原材料|げんざいりょう}{名|めい} (ingredient name), where all ingredients must be listed by law.

MANUFACTURING/ECONOMICS:
- {原材料|げんざいりょう}{費|ひ}: raw material costs
- {原材料|げんざいりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{調達|ちょうたつ}→調達：09938_choutatsu⟧: procurement of raw materials
- {原材料|げんざいりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{高騰|こうとう}→高騰：14647_koutou⟧: soaring raw material prices

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{原料|げんりょう}→原料：11802_genryou⟧: raw material (often for processed goods — chemicals, paper, etc.)
- ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧: material, ingredient (general term)
- {原材料|げんざいりょう}: raw materials (comprehensive term covering both ⟦{原料|げんりょう}→原料：11802_genryou⟧ and ⟦{材料|ざいりょう}→材料：02831_zairyou⟧)
- ⟦{食材|しょくざい}→食材：04940_shokuzai⟧: food ingredient (for cooking)
